Get FDP+ Diagnostic Estimates Across the Swept Thresholds

get_fdrs.Rd

Returns the vector of FDP+ diagnostic estimates computed by stabl_fit() across the swept stability thresholds.

Usage

get_fdrs(object)

Arguments

object

A fitted "stabl_fit" object returned by stabl_fit().

Value

Named numeric vector with one FDP+ estimate per swept stability threshold (names taken from the fit's fdr_threshold_range).

Details

These are diagnostic estimates used to choose the stability threshold, not a guarantee that false discovery proportion is controlled at any level. Calibration depends on the artificial features acting as fair null competitors. Fails with an error when the fit was produced without artificial features (artificial_type = NULL).

See also

get_stabl_scores() for the full selection-frequency path, get_lambda_grid() for the penalty grid used.

Examples

set.seed(1L)
x <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 6), 40, 6,
            dimnames = list(paste0("s", 1:40), paste0("f", 1:6)))
y <- setNames(rnorm(40), rownames(x))
fit <- stabl_fit(x, y,
                 lambda_grid    = data.frame(lambda = c(0.2, 0.1, 0.05)),
                 n_bootstraps   = 4L,
                 artificial_type = "random_permutation",
                 random_state   = 1L)
fdrs <- get_fdrs(fit)  # named numeric, one FDP+ estimate per threshold
fdrs
